representative.title: A Sensitive Coupled Enzyme Assay for Measuring Kinase and ATPase Activity
representative.assay: Coupled kinase and ATPase activity assay
representative.operation: Measure ATP consumption through an ADP-specific hexokinase/G6PDH coupling readout and fit initial rates across substrate concentrations with a Michaelis-Menten model
representative.methodVariant: Continuous NADH-linked absorbance readout at 340 nm with ATP substrate series and initial-rate Michaelis-Menten fitting
representative.selectionNote: Specific Bio-protocol record with an explicit substrate series, continuous A340 readout, cuvette instrument, and Michaelis-Menten fitting context. The record page documents its publication metadata and states that Bio-protocol is the exclusive licensee; no permissive reuse code was inferred.

screened.title: Rapid and Accessible ELISA-Based Enzyme Kinetics Assay
screened.reason: Relevant enzyme kinetics record with a quantitative assay, but its endpoint ELISA readout and colorimetric plate workflow are a materially different readout from continuous spectrophotometric kinetics.

screened.title: Fitting enzyme kinetics data with Solver
screened.reason: Useful Michaelis-Menten fitting workflow, but it is a data-analysis protocol rather than a complete enzyme activity assay.

representative.title: Enzymatic Ethanol Assay V.2
representative.assay: Ethanol concentration measurement by ADH-coupled NADH absorbance
representative.operation: Quantify ethanol in a 96-well plate from time-resolved A340 and an ethanol standard curve
representative.methodVariant: ADH-coupled NADH increase at 340 nm in a 96-well plate at 30 C with kinetic readout and four-parameter standard-curve fitting
representative.selectionNote: Versioned protocols.io record with a stable DOI, explicit target analyte (ethanol), wavelength (340 nm), plate reader, temperature, kinetic readout, and standard-curve model. The record PDF states a CC BY 4.0 license.

screened.title: Measurement of Glucose-6-phosphate Dehydrogenase Activity in Cyanobacteria and E. coli
screened.reason: Strong A340 spectrophotometric assay, but the target is enzyme activity in cell-free extracts rather than direct metabolite concentration and the readout is cuvette-based.

screened.title: NADH-linked microtiter plate-based assay for measuring Rubisco activity
screened.reason: Matches the microplate/NADH readout pattern, but is a specific Rubisco enzyme-activity variant and is less general for metabolite measurement.

representative.title: Protein-peptide Interaction by Surface Plasmon Resonance
representative.assay: Protein-peptide interaction and kinetic binding measurement
representative.operation: Immobilize a protein ligand by amine coupling on a CM5 chip and measure peptide analyte binding on a Biacore X100
representative.specimen: Purified protein ligand and synthetic peptide analyte
representative.platform: Biacore X100 with CM5 sensor chip and Biacore X100 Evaluation Software
representative.methodVariant: Amine-coupled ligand format with peptide analyte prepared in DMSO; direct SPR response and kinetic binding analysis
representative.selectionNote: Specific protocol record with ligand immobilization mode, CM5 chip, peptide analyte format, Biacore X100 platform, and DOI. The record page documents publication metadata and states that Bio-protocol is the exclusive licensee; no permissive reuse code was inferred.

screened.title: Preparation of Oleyl Ethylene Glycol Sreptavidin Surface for SPR
screened.reason: Relevant SPR platform record, but it is a sensor-surface preparation workflow and does not itself provide a complete ligand-analyte binding assay.

screened.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Assay
screened.reason: Technically relevant Biacore 3000 binding assay, but the exchange page does not expose a stable DOI or record-level reuse license in the available metadata.
